comparison.objective: Hold a part at a marked height while closing a vise; candidate iteratively adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual part positioning and coarse knob turning to clamp versus counterholding a small body, recessed key use, fine collar rotation, and bounded setscrew torque.
comparison.success_condition: Part clamped at 5 N-plus, upright, and within 2 mm of height; candidate requires safe repeated impacts and post-lock drift tolerance.
comparison.reason: Both involve stabilization and rotary tightening, but vise workholding is a one-shot pose-and-clamp task, not continuous dynamic tuning.
